tasks.title: 1-1. The total area of the solar panel system you observed is 365.4…
tasks.statement:
1-1. The total area of the solar panel system you observed is 365.4 m​2​. Calculate the
total solar radiation per second that the solar panel system absorbed. The answer should
be rounded off to the first decimal place.

1-2. Calculate the percentage of solar radiation energy that can be converted to electrical
energy by the solar panel system. The answer should be rounded off to the first decimal
place.

parts.question: Приведите полное решение (с доказательством или выводом).

tasks.title: A conversion table from the rotation rate of the wind turbine to the…
tasks.statement:
A conversion table from the rotation rate of the wind turbine to the wind speed as well
as power generation by the wind turbine is provided in the exam room. If there is no
rotation, the rotation rate will be given by the supervisor of the exam.

2-1. By using the following mathematical formula, calculate the kinetic energy of the air
that passes a circle swept by the rotating blades of a wind turbine per second:
0.5 × ρ × π × r​2​ × V​3
Here, ρ is air density (1.2 kg/m​3​), π is the ratio of the circumference of a circle to its
diameter (use 3.14), r is the radius of the circle (33.0 m), and V is the wind speed that
you converted from the rotation rate. The unit is watt. The answer should be rounded off
to the first decimal place.

2-2. Convert the observed rotation rate to the electrical power generation of the wind
turbine by using the conversion table. In this condition, calculate the percentage of wind
energy that can be converted to electrical energy by the wind turbine. The answer
should be rounded off to the first decimal place.

parts.question: Приведите полное решение (с доказательством или выводом).
